emi.info.oak_swamp_mud: Growing a oak tree on top of a mud block results in a swamp oak tree.
emi.info.oak_basic_muddy_mangrove_roots: Growing a oak tree on top of a muddy mangrove roots block always results in a basic oak tree.
emi.info.oak_bush_podzol: Growing a oak tree on top of a podzol block results in a oak bush.
emi.info.oak_fancy_coarse_dirt: Growing a oak tree on top of a coarse dirt block results in a fancy oak tree.
emi.info.oak_fancy_large_rooted_dirt: Growing a oak tree on top of a rooted dirt block results in a larger fancy oak tree.
emi.info.birch_regular_coarse_dirt: Growing a birch tree on top of a coarse dirt block results in a regular (vanilla) birch tree.
emi.info.acacia_bush_podzol: Growing a acacia tree on top of a podzol block results in a acacia bush.
emi.info.spruce_bush_rooted_dirt: Growing a (1x1) spruce tree on top of a rooted dirt block results in a spruce bush.
emi.info.spruce_mega_rooted_dirt2: Growing a 2x2 spruce tree on top of a rooted dirt block results in a mega spruce tree.
emi.info.spruce_pine_mega_moss_block: Growing a 2x2 spruce tree on top of a moss block results in a mega pine tree.
emi.info.jungle_fancy_rooted_dirt: Growing a 2x2 jungle tree on top of a rooted dirt block results in a fancy mega jungle tree.
emi.info.dark_oak_large_rooted_dirt: Growing a 2x2 dark oak tree on top of a rooted dirt block results in a large dark oak tree.
emi.info.dark_oak_tall_coarse_dirt: Growing a 2x2 dark oak tree on top of a coarse dirt block results in a tall dark oak tree.
emi.info.aspen_bush_podzol: Growing a aspen tree on top of a podzol block results in a aspen bush.
emi.info.mahogany_large_rooted_dirt: Growing a 2x2 mahogany tree on top of a rooted dirt block results in a large mahogany tree.
emi.info.willow_large_rooted_dirt: Growing a 2x2 willow tree on top of a rooted dirt block results in a large willow tree.
emi.info.sugi_large_rooted_dirt: Growing a 2x2 sugi tree on top of a rooted dirt block results in a large sugi tree.
emi.info.red_maple_large_rooted_dirt: Growing a 2x2 red maple tree on top of a rooted dirt block results in a large red maple tree.
emi.info.orange_maple_large_rooted_dirt: Growing a 2x2 orange maple tree on top of a rooted dirt block results in a large orange maple tree.
emi.info.yellow_maple_large_rooted_dirt: Growing a 2x2 yellow maple tree on top of a rooted dirt block results in a large yellow maple tree.
emi.info.white_wisteria_tall_rooted_dirt: Growing a white wisteria tree on top of a rooted dirt block results in a tall white wisteria tree.
emi.info.blue_wisteria_tall_rooted_dirt: Growing a blue wisteria tree on top of a rooted dirt block results in a tall blue wisteria tree.
emi.info.purple_wisteria_tall_rooted_dir: Growing a purple wisteria tree on top of a rooted dirt block results in a tall purple wisteria tree.
emi.info.pink_wisteria_tall_rooted_dirt: Growing a pink wisteria tree on top of a rooted dirt block results in a tall pink wisteria tree.
